proves: The db:verify rules catch real drift. Run against a scratch copy of `demo` where one instance was deliberately broken by hand, the rules named the four things that were broken (V11, V6, V7, V21) and exited 1. The exit code 1 below is the proof working, not a broken platform.
whyNotPlatformHealth: A deliberately broken database is evidence about the checker, never about the platform. Recording it as platform health made /admin/health read Fail permanently and hid any real regression in the noise (#599). The platform record is written from a clean `demo` run only.
